description: This file defines the 'Basket' entity class used in the shopping cart feature of the application. It manages basket items, provides methods for adding/removing items, and maintains basket properties such as total items and buyer ID.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with items, buyer information, and methods to modify its contents.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the basket or increments the quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes all items with zero quantity from the basket.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
